setup_registry: setup a new fairseq registry with a name, optional base class, default, and required flag
build_x: build a registered component instance from a DictConfig, string name, or argparse Namespace config
register_x: register a class in a fairseq registry with an optional FairseqDataclass for Hydra config support
register_x_cls: register a class with duplicate name and base class validation checks in the registry
REGISTRIES: access the global REGISTRIES dictionary to inspect all registered fairseq component registries
